name: IsVisible.of_convexHull_of_pos
statement: Type*} {t : Finset ι} {a : ι → V} {w : ι → 𝕜} (hw₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (hw₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (ha : ∀ i ∈ t, a i ∈ s) (hx : x ∉ convexHull 𝕜 s) (hw : IsVisible 𝕜 (convexHull 𝕜 s) x (∑ i ∈ t, w i • a i)) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ t) (hwi : 0 < w i) : IsVisible 𝕜 (convexHull 𝕜 s) x (a i)

name: IsClosed.exists_wbtw_isVisible
statement: IsClosed s) (hy : y ∈ s) (x : V) : ∃ z ∈ s, Wbtw ℝ x z y ∧ IsVisible ℝ s x z
